title: Amazing Slow Cooker French Toast
description: This amazing slow-cooker French toast recipe includes cinnamon-raisin bread, vanilla, allspice, and apples. Some say it's more of a bread pudding.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, or to taste
1 teaspoon ground allspice, or to taste
1 (16 ounce) loaf cinnamon-raisin bread, torn into chunks

steps.text: Grease the inside of a slow cooker.
Place apple pieces in the prepared slow cooker; sprinkle brown sugar on top, then dot with butter slices.
Whisk eggs, milk, vanilla extract, and allspice together in a bowl until smooth; add raisins. Stir bread chunks into egg mixture until saturated; transfer to the slow cooker. Cover slow cooker.

video.description: This amazing slow cooker recipe has to be the easiest way to make French toast for a crowd. In this video, learn how to make French toast in the slow cooker with the same simple ingredients as the original stovetop version – plus an extra layer of chopped apples and brown sugar. While cooking, thick chunks of cinnamon-raisin bread soak up the rich egg custard and develop a sweet caramelization that makes this recipe a true fan-favorite for homemade breakfast and brunch.
